description:
PDF editor for Windows that also reads EPUB and DjVu. No account, no subscription, no telemetry.

KillerPDF is a free, open-source PDF editor for Windows. View, annotate, edit text and paragraphs, OCR, merge, split, sign and verify signatures, fill and build forms, redact, protect, compare, print and flatten PDFs, export them to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML or Markdown, read EPUB books and DjVu scans and convert them to PDF, and repeat the work with macros, watched folders and the command line, all without an Adobe subscription. WinGet installs machine-wide; the downloadable installer also supports per-user installation, and a separate portable build is available. Document processing stays on your computer, with no account, no subscription, and no telemetry. Open source under GPLv3.
1.9.3 reads EPUB and DjVu books natively with Convert to PDF, selects and extracts pictures, color-manages viewing and printer proofing on standard monitors with HDR still in progress, opens large PDFs faster, turns the page and markup right-click menus into cards, deletes pages in one step, splits a PDF into one file per page or every few pages, turns images into a PDF straight from File Explorer, lets Enter save a text box, and fixes redaction, cropping, form saving, merging, printing, stamps, updates and the file picker.

### Security

- Redacting one copy of a form field that appears in several places removes its value from every copy of the field in the saved file, not only from the field itself; the other copies stay as empty fields, and the other buttons of a radio or check box group stay visible and switched off.

### Fixed

- Crop keeps the area you drew on pages whose box does not start at the page corner, including a page cropped a second time, crops the page you drew on in Continuous view, sizes its fields from that page, follows All and the page range when you press Enter in a field, and no longer freezes on a very large end page.
- Pictures and image watermarks in a format the page shows but saving could not read, such as JPEG XR, appear in saved, printed and flattened copies instead of disappearing from them.
- PDFs whose layer settings leave out their list of layers show their pages instead of a blank page. (#476)
- In split view, Delete removes the annotation selected in the pane you are working in instead of a form field selected in the other pane.
- Printing at a Custom scale above 100% or at Actual size prints a page larger than the printable area at that size instead of shrinking it to fit, and a page that fills the printable area in one direction prints without a thin white edge.
- The Stamp window keeps typed sizes within the slider range, reads a decimal size typed with either separator, keeps a watermark font that is not installed, resets every setting with Reset all, does nothing on Enter when there is nothing to apply, and names its page buttons for screen readers.
- A picture or text box resize cut short by a redraw can be undone and marks the document as changed.
- A dismissed restricted-PDF notice stays dismissed when its tab moves to another pane or window, and switching away while drawing a level line in Transform ends the line.
- Rasterize Region places its image exactly over the selected area on pages whose crop box does not start at the corner of the page, and the area it replaces no longer stays live underneath.
- Changing a selected ink stroke's or text box's color, size, opacity or font from the options bar can be undone in one step.
- Paragraph edits keep supported colored highlights and still refuse opaque covers. (#413)
- The first text highlight on a page can be undone and redone. (#485)
- A per-user or portable update that fails now reopens KillerPDF instead of leaving it closed, including when antivirus or a locked-down PowerShell stops the update helper from loading or the downloaded update is removed or changed after KillerPDF closes, and a published copy that fails its final check is swapped back for the previous version and never started.
- Searchable PDFs made with OCR, and other saves that add text, open in Adobe Reader again. Added fonts carry their complete encoding details, and saves keep the original file's cross-reference format.
- An update started from an administrator's copy, installed or portable, reopens KillerPDF at normal rights. An update that is applied but cannot record its version in the registry now finishes and reopens instead of reporting failure, and putting the previous copy back after a failed update retries a busy file and survives a leftover from an earlier attempt.
- Updating KillerPDF no longer removes a relaunch another Killer app scheduled for its own update.
- Updates show requested recovery reports, avoid recreating them after success, and remove inactive relaunch tasks.
- Text fields with automatic font sizing save correctly and keep their original border and background styling. Untagged fields can be deleted from tagged PDFs without changing the page's existing tags. (#477)
- Independent fields keep their own values and form settings. Added text saves above existing comments and reopens as one editable multiline box. (#466)
- Merge accepts more PDFs with optional popup links, saved appearances and resource metadata, and preserves nested form fonts and alignment. (#455)
- Large PDFs open faster and use far less memory. On a slower test PC a 10,000-page PDF shows its first page in about 7 seconds instead of 11 and peaks at about 540 MB instead of 1.5 GB, and a 20,000-page PDF in about 9 seconds instead of 20, at about 700 MB instead of 1.9 GB. Opening reads and copies the file fewer times, page thumbnails are drawn only for the pages in view, each page is built and its links read when it is drawn, and pages scrolled to below 100% are drawn at the size they appear.
- Grid view keeps only the pages near the screen in memory and draws those first, so a long document in Grid no longer climbs into gigabytes, a page you jump to shows at once, and typing stays responsive.
- Filled Shapes rectangles retain their color and opacity in print previews, printed output and flattened copies. (#474)
- Highlights color the paper and keep the text under them dark at any opacity, on screen and in saved, printed and flattened copies, and the opacity you set now applies to those copies too. Selecting a filled Shapes rectangle opens the Shapes settings.
- Printing a page much larger than the paper no longer fails with a render limit error. Each page renders at the size it prints, and a page too large even at Actual size prints at a lower resolution. (#481)
- With Fit to page, landscape pages in a portrait print job, and portrait pages in a landscape one, turn to fill the sheet instead of printing small. The preview shows the same turn. (#482)
- PDFs without saved annotation appearances show note markers and ink strokes, and highlights keep their page positions when their stored rectangle is incorrect.
- Text extraction recovers missing marked-content properties and stray closing tags in compatibility mode.
- Text selection keeps separate rectangular panels apart. New searchable PDFs fit TrueType text to OCR word heights so short words stay on their lines. (#465)
- JPEG 2000 images use their encoded sample depth when the PDF declares a different value.
- Gradient mesh shadings have smooth clipped edges instead of jagged ones.
- Rasterize Region keeps earlier region images intact on repeated operations and leaves invisible clipping paths out of its content counts. (#369)
- Zoomed page details stay aligned when scrolling, and switching from Continuous to Single-page viewing keeps the correct zoom.
- Returning to a tab at Fit Page fits the page to the view again, so the page is no longer cut off after another tab opens.
- Leaving full screen puts the window back at its earlier width instead of leaving it much wider, and a narrow split window at a large app scale keeps room for both panes instead of squeezing the second one to a sliver.
- KillerPDF reopens where it was last closed, maximized included, when a PDF is opened from another monitor, and a tab moved to a new window opens beside the window it came from instead of on top of it or maximized. (#487) (Thanks @Ryokoxx)
- Transform, Color correction and Stamp on a page with comments or text boxes show an error when the temporary folder cannot be written, instead of a crash report.
- The table export window keeps its format choice, Cancel and Export buttons fully inside the window at a large app scale on a short screen instead of cutting off their bottom edge.
- Save Flattened shows output pixel dimensions and scale, matching image export. (#462)
- View controls follow the active tab or pane, and opening a document during a sidebar transition keeps its thumbnails visible. (#473)
- The file picker no longer stalls on a disconnected network folder when it opens, a relative or malformed path typed in the path box is refused instead of being looked up against the wrong folder, a pattern such as *.log typed in the name box filters the list, and a full path typed in the name box, quoted or not, can be accepted even when the shown folder failed to list.
- PDF creation, modification, comment and attachment dates use the Gregorian calendar on Thai, Arabic and Persian region settings instead of writing years like 2569.
- The update check reads only the release's own fields, so release notes that quote them cannot confuse it.
- The file picker loads icons and picture previews in the background, refreshes overwritten previews, and restores its position on any monitor.
- Recent files appear immediately after an update reopens an empty window.
- Make Searchable opens its save dialog in the original PDF's folder instead of the last-used folder.
- The visible signature date uses the same year-month-day format on every region setting.
- Flatten Layers works on layered PDFs with added text instead of stopping with a "Layer is still referenced" error.
- A grouped text box stays in its group after its text is edited.
- Changing the file type in the save picker while the name box holds characters no file name can carry keeps the name as typed and shows the invalid-path message.
- `killerpdf search-text` searches for a query that starts with two dashes, such as `--json`, instead of reading it as an option, so a search can no longer leave the command waiting for input.
- The footer copyright has a single space between the year and the name, and the version and copyright come from the family footer, so their distance from the corner grip matches the other Killer apps.

The full release notes are at https://github.com/SteveTheKiller/KillerPDF/releases/tag/v1.9.3
